clues.text: After Daniel explained the king's dream, he was made ruler over this whole province and its wise men.
Walking on his palace roof, a king boasted that he had built this great city by his own power.
A king set up a golden statue sixty cubits high on the plain of Dura in this province.
In John's vision, an angel cried out that this great city had fallen and become a lair for demons.
After his illness, King Hezekiah told Isaiah that his visitors had come from this distant land.
Nebuchadnezzar carried King Jehoiachin, his mother and Jerusalem's leading men away into exile here.
Jeremiah wrote that when this place's seventy years were complete, God would bring His people home.
